title: TikTok Explore/Trending Scraper Input
description: Collect the public TikTok Explore feed with no login or cookies. All=120 is the default; 123 is accepted as a legacy alias. Optional country selection, filters, only-new monitoring, transcript text, post-detail enrichment and Key-Value Store media rehosting are additive.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Categories to collect. Accepts names, numeric IDs, or legacy {id,name} objects. All=120; topics 100-119: Anime & Comics, Shows, Beauty Care, Games, Comedy, Daily Life, Family, Relationship, Drama, Outfit, Lipsync, Food, Sports, Animals, Society, Cars, Education, Fitness & Health, Technology, Singing & Dancing. 123 is accepted as a legacy alias for All. 121/122 (empty upstream) and 124+ (invalid upstream) are skipped with a warning.

maxItemsPerCategory.title: Max Items Per Category
maxItemsPerCategory.description: Hard cap on emitted posts per category. The cap is applied before any page is pushed, so a 30-item page never overshoots. The default is 3 because media rehosting is on by default and adds one browser page plus several HTTP media fetches per emitted post.

maxItems.title: Max Items (legacy alias)
maxItems.description: Legacy alias for maxItemsPerCategory. It is used when maxItemsPerCategory is absent or exactly the default 3; an explicitly non-default maxItemsPerCategory wins.

categoryId.title: Category ID (legacy shorthand)
categoryId.description: Legacy shorthand for one category. It replaces the categories list. 100-120 are accepted; 123 maps to 120; other values are skipped with a warning.

autoDiscoverCategories.title: Auto-Discover All Categories
autoDiscoverCategories.description: When true, an empty or All-only selection expands to all 21 verified Explore categories. If specific categories are selected, the missing categories are appended.

countries.title: Countries / Markets
countries.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 markets. Empty means the actor's current egress and no proxy. Each selected country uses a per-country Apify proxy (AUTO first, residential only after a proven block). The feed follows the egress IP, not a query parameter.

country.title: Country (shorthand)
country.description: Single-country shorthand. Ignored when countries is non-empty.

postedWithin.title: Posted Within
postedWithin.description: Client-side filter on createTime relative to the run start.

minViews.title: Minimum Views
minViews.description: Drop posts with fewer playCount views. Missing stats fail a positive threshold.

minLikes.title: Minimum Likes
minLikes.description: Drop posts with fewer likes. Missing stats fail a positive threshold.

minComments.title: Minimum Comments
minComments.description: Drop posts with fewer comments. Missing stats fail a positive threshold.

minShares.title: Minimum Shares
minShares.description: Drop posts with fewer shares. Missing stats fail a positive threshold.

onlyNew.title: Only New Posts
onlyNew.description: Emit only posts that were not present in the named state store. State is read and written only when this is true.

stateKey.title: Only-New State Key
stateKey.description: Optional key-value store key for onlyNew. When empty, a deterministic key is derived from categories, countries and filters.

includeTranscripts.title: Include Transcript Text
includeTranscripts.description: Fetch subtitle WebVTT URLs and add subtitles[].text. Subtitle metadata is always returned when available; text is opt-in and fail-soft.

includePostDetails.title: Include Post Details
includePostDetails.description: Fetch the public post detail page for each selected post (bounded to the emitted maxItems) and merge locationCreated plus poi/imagePost when the feed omitted them. Detail requests are fail-soft: a 403, stub page or parse failure keeps the original post. Adds one page request per emitted row.

rehostVideo.title: Rehost Media in Key-Value Store
rehostVideo.description: Open each emitted post with Playwright to capture the real video/mp4 response, then HTTP-fetch the signed cover, originCover, dynamicCover, zoomCover, avatar, music, slideshow image and subtitle files. Every captured payload is stored in the run's default key-value store and the original signed URL is kept as a <field>Original value plus in mediaSources. video.playUrl and video.downloadUrl use tiktok-video-{postId}.mp4; other media use typed tiktok-{kind}-{postId}-... keys. Rehosting is fail-soft per field and never drops a post. It adds one browser page plus several media fetches per emitted record and increases run time and KV storage use; keep maxItemsPerCategory small.
